resources.string: Connected. Requests over this code show up here for you to approve.
Done: the other side closed the connection. Each request on the computer shows a new code to scan.

This code connects this phone to whatever showed it — Freedom on your computer, if that’s where you scanned it — so the phone can sign for it. Each signature or transaction it asks for is shown here first; nothing is signed without you.
Working out the network fee and nonce… Nothing is signed or sent until you confirm on the next screen.
Nothing was signed or sent. The code you scanned is told why once you close this.
Asked for over the code you scanned. Only approve if that code came from Freedom on your own computer.
The code you scanned asks to add an account of this wallet. It learns the account’s address, nothing else; every signature or transaction it asks for later is shown here first.
Signing proves this account agreed to the message. It can’t move funds by itself, but only sign messages you understand.
Any — the signature names no chain
It could be used on any network where this contract accepts it
A chain this phone doesn’t have set up
Typed data can authorise things — a permit to spend your tokens, an order, a multisig transaction. Only sign it if you started this on your computer.

Only pages you open yourself or reach by tapping on the site, not ones it moves to on its own; and after the site refuses a payment, not until you open or reload it yourself. Only while the wallet is unlocked, never in a private tab. With another account active, you\'re asked again. Revoke it any time on the wallet page.
